title: OpenAI’s DevDay pushes ChatGPT toward an agent platform
friendlyTitle: ChatGPT is becoming a place where people and agents work together
summary: OpenAI announced more than 20 updates spanning persistent Dots agents, GPT-6.1 Sol, reusable Codex cloud environments, computer use in the Agents API, richer plugins and third-party access to ChatGPT plan usage. Availability varies by product and plan, with several enterprise controls and developer features rolling out in stages.
friendlySummary: OpenAI announced many updates, including agents that keep working, a cheaper model, cloud tools for Codex, stronger plugins, and ways to use a ChatGPT plan in other apps. Some features are only on certain plans or are still being released.
whyItMatters: The announcements make ChatGPT less like a single conversation and more like a work surface where agents, apps and people share context. Teams should evaluate the new capabilities as a connected platform, while setting explicit permissions, review points and spending limits before handing agents ongoing responsibilities.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could reduce the need to move between separate AI tools. Before giving an agent regular work, decide what it may access, what a person must approve, and how much it may spend.
